name: education-dt-showcase
description: Open commercial showcase of Education DT by Software DT. Not the product.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @edu-dt/api" "npm run dev -w @edu-dt/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @edu-dt/content && npm run typecheck -w @edu-dt/api && npm run typecheck -w @edu-dt/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @edu-dt/content && npm run test -w @edu-dt/api
